headline: Review Eryri National Park Parking and Public Transport
reservation: While no hiking permit is required, the primary car parks at Dôl Idris and Tŷ Nant are run by Eryri National Park and require card payment. These lots frequently fill during busy periods, necessitating an early arrival or use of the T2 Trawscymru bus service. Check official park status for up-to-date parking charges and potential closures.

days.title: The Giant's Summit

stops.name: Cadair Idris
stops.detail: Ascend the Penygadair summit via the Pony Path for views over the Mawddach estuary or the steeper Minffordd Path past Llyn Cau. The summit offers a small shelter and views ranging from the coast to the inland hills of Y Bala.

days.driving: Allow 15-30 mins for local parking transfer; conditions vary
days.note: Allow five to six hours for the round trip; ensure you carry all necessary food and water as no facilities exist at the summit.

intel.title: Trailhead Lots
intel.text: Dôl Idris and Tŷ Nant car parks accept card payments only and are managed by the National Park. The Llanfihangel y Pennant village car park is free but has very limited capacity.

intel.title: Mountain Safety
intel.text: Paths are designated as strenuous with significant cliff edges that become hazardous in low visibility. Staying overnight at the peak is discouraged due to exposed conditions and unpredictable weather.

intel.title: Early Starts
intel.text: Arrive at trailheads early as parking spaces fill quickly during peak season. Allow a full morning and afternoon for the hike to avoid descending in fading light.

intel.title: Local Supplies
intel.text: The evidence does not specify fuel station locations; verify refueling options in Dolgellau or Machynlleth before heading to the trailheads. Ensure vehicles have sufficient fuel for mountain roads.

intel.title: Connectivity Gaps
intel.text: Specific mobile signal data for the peaks is not provided in official sources. Download offline maps and plan for potential communication gaps in the glacial cwms.

plan.arrival: Arrive via rail at Machynlleth or Tywyn, then transfer to the T2 Trawscymru bus which stops at Minffordd for the trailhead. If driving, base in Dolgellau for the closest access to the Tŷ Nant car park.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable for the main trailhead roads; check for narrow lane restrictions if heading toward Llanfihangel y Pennant.
plan.goldenHour: Penygadair summit for views over the Mawddach estuary at sunset, seasonal visibility permitting.
